verses.1: To be sung in musical melodies for the purpose of worshiping God.
verses.2: In Judah, God is known as a great God in Israel.
verses.3: And in Shelem, there was a tent and its furnishings.
verses.4: It sealed the breaches in the walls of defense, as well as those caused by war and destruction.
verses.5: You are indeed a great one among those who are powerful.
verses.6: They were lost and helpless; their hearts were empty. They couldn’t find anyone who could help them.
verses.7: By your anger, O God of Jacob! You have caused me to tremble and to be in fear.
verses.8: You are the Light; you are the one who stands before you from that time onward.
verses.9: From heaven, you heard the sound of the earth that was silent and still.
verses.10: Let God rise up to judge all the nations of the earth.
verses.11: For as a man’s love for you lasts, so too will the love of others for you.
verses.12: May you and your families be strong in the Lord. All those around you will bring blessings upon you.
verses.13: The spirit of judgment will be revealed to the kings of the earth.
